item.name: Create Order with Multiple Services (User) - Saved Location

request.description: Creates a new order with multiple services and quantities. Perfect for mobile app scenarios like the service request UI shown in the image. This example uses a saved location (savedLocationId: 1). Alternatively, you can use currentLocation: {"latitude": 40.7128, "longitude": -74.0060, "address": "Current address"} for real-time location.

item.name: Create Order with Multiple Services (User) - Current Location

request.description: Creates a new order with multiple services using real-time current location coordinates.
